_game: AI GameStore game9 (Mega Man-like action platformer)
_note: uv sync --extra aigamestore: the vendored aigamestore-gym env (gym/aigamestore), which needs a Chromium browser (system Chrome by default). Lock-stepped: fps must equal 60 / frame_skip (10 with the default frame_skip 6).
_levels_note: An episode is one level: it ends on a win, a loss or a level clear, and reset() restarts the same level. Levels 1..7 are listed, one phase each; drop or reorder them as the session needs. Blocking, as the game is: each block is its level played until cleared (mode 'episode', n_episodes 1, advancing_outcomes ['won']); a loss restarts the same level, so the levels run back to back at the subject's own pace, and max_duration 120 s is the cap on a level nobody clears.
_keys_note: The env's action is MultiBinary over the game's keys, in aigamestore_gym.GAME_KEYS order -- game9: 0=LEFT, 1=RIGHT, 2=UP, 3=DOWN, 4=Z, 5=SPACE, 6=LSHIFT -- so 'keys' values are those indices (the JSON key is what the subject presses) and held keys combine. The env relabels the on-canvas hints to the pressed key; keep the message Controls text in sync with 'keys' by hand.

text: defeat bosses, and unlock their weapons.
